title: 8 Man
synopsis: Murdered by criminals, Detective Yokoda's body is retrieved by Professor Tani and taken to his laboratory. There, Tani performs an experiment that has failed seven times; Yokoda is the latest subject to have his life force transferred into an android body. For the first time, the experiment succeeds. Yokoda is reborn as the armor-skinned android 8 Man, able to dash at impossible speeds, as well as shape-shift into other people. He shifts himself into Yokoda, this time christening himself as "Hachiro Azuma". He keeps this identity a secret, known only to Tani and his police boss Chief Tanaka. Even his girlfriend Sachiko and friend Ichiro do not know he is an android. As 8-Man, Hachiro fights crime (even bringing his murderers to justice).

title: Lazy Girl Momogusa
titleNative: 桃草さんがものぐさすぎる!!
synopsis: Souji Hataki is an ordinary high school boy who has just landed the perfect new part-time job as a housekeeper for the house of Momogusa. What’s so significant about that? It just so happens to be the home of the most beautiful girl in school! Perfect, pretty, and popular, Momogusa-san is amazing at everything she does and now Hataki will have a chance to see her in her element. But, he quickly learns something shocking: Momogusa is incredibly lazy at home! The moment she’s home from school, she seems to transform into a totally different version of herself and even expects to be pampered! Somehow she grows fond of Hataki and even begins to let him pamper her. Could this be the start of some sort of relationship or is Hataki just a glorified manservant? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

title: Maou-sama no Kinyoubi
synonyms: The Demon Lord's Day Off: Friday
synopsis: The Demon Lord, who was once defeated in battle by a hero, was suddenly transported from the demon world to modern-day Japan due to a runaway spell she cast at the end of the battle. Having efficiently recovered most of the magical power she had lost in the previous battle by consuming modern food, the Demon Lord returns to the Demon World once again. Despite reigning over the demon world as the Demon Lord, she frequently makes secret visits to Japan, spending her days eating easily obtainable convenience store food. One day, by chance, she came across a back alley in a busy downtown area and ended up helping a girl who was being harassed by several men. As a reward for helping her, she was taken to a cozy oden restaurant... The serious and rigid "Demon Lord" discovers truly delicious food and drinks, and friends to share them with after work. (Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)
